title: MissionDefinition
description: A composition, declared as data. The ordered steps ARE the graph: LangGraph iterates them, and adding a provider means adding a definition and a pack rather than a branch. This is the contract that makes 'if target == aws-terraform ... elif target == azure-terraform' unnecessary, and a test greps the kernel to keep it that way.

target_profile_id.description: Binding of generic inspector names and skill sets to concrete tooling, applied to every step that asks for one.

pack_id.description: Resolved against the pack registry at composition time. A step naming a candidate pack fails to compose - it does not silently run unapproved code.

evidence_required.description: Generic requirement names only. What satisfies them is the target profile's business.
